english.title: Fail to comply with a direction to cease / not start prohibited activity in a Royal park / other open space

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: The Royal Parks and Other Open Spaces amendment No2 Regulations 2012
Royal Parks and Other Open Spaces Regulations 1992

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse failed to comply with a direction given by a constable

(A)_[to cease a prohibited activity,]_
(B)_[not to start a prohibited activity,]_

namely

(C)_[operating amplified noise equipment]_
(D)_[erecting a tent]_
(E)_[keeping a tent erected]_
(F)_[erecting a structure designed or adapted for the purpose of facilitating sleeping or staying in a place for any period]_
(G)_[using a tent or other such structure for the purpose of sleeping or staying in that area]_
(H)_[placing or keeping in place sleeping equipment with a view to its use for the purpose of sleeping overnight in that area]_
(I)_[using sleeping equipment for the purpose of sleeping overnight in that area]_

in a designated park specified in paragraph 1, 3A or 20 of Schedule 1 to the Royal Parks and Other Open Spaces Regulations 1997, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PARK..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 3A of the Royal Parks and Other Open Spaces Regulations 1997 and section 2 of the Parks Regulation (Amendment) Act 1926.

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 5 provides:-
Where a constable has reasonable ground for belief that a person hascontravened any one or more of these Regulations, that person shall give ondemand his name and address to that constable.
(ii) Regulation 6 provides:-
6(1) The provisions of this regulation shall have effect:-
(a) where an officer, servant or agent of the Secretary of State is acting in theperformance of his duty to secure the proper management of a Park or thepreservation of order and prevention of abuses therein, or
(b) where a constable or a member of the armed forces or of any fire brigade orambulance service is acting in the performance of his duty.
(iii) Regulation 6(2) provides:-
Any such person mentioned in paragraph (1) above is for the purpose ofregulations 2 and 4hereby granted permission to do any act mentioned in those regulations.
(iv) Regulation 3A(8) specifies a "designated park" as any park listed in paragraphs 1,3A and 20 of Schedule 1.
